claim_triggers.description: Deficit rainfall or adverse seasonal conditions preventing 75% of normal sown area in notified unit.
Severe drought, dry spells, unseasonal heavy floods during standing crop cycle.
Unseasonal rainfall or cyclonic inundation while harvested crop is drying in the field (up to 14 days).
Isolated hailstorm, landslide, cloudburst, or inundation affecting individual farm survey numbers.
